name: Kazama Kouji
source:
A classmate of the heroines. He has always been quiet and has had little presence in the class, but he is determined to become more active upon entering the school.

He treats Akemi with good intentions in his new class, but due to a misunderstanding, he is accused by Chiaki who is protective of Akemi.

He becomes the laughing stock of the class and an outcast. Kouji despairs of the next three years of school life, and this despair eventually takes a sinister form. His desire for the two heroines begins to run rampant.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/ryomaden/index.html]official site[/url]]
